# FM1Kit

> A Swift package (MIT) for installing firmware on the M-VAVE FM-1 over USB-MIDI, from iOS and macOS. It reads `.fwsc` packages, installs and resumes updates, restores V15's factory voices, backs up M-VAVE's open firmware and installs m-bootloader; on macOS it also backs up, restores and writes the whole flash in the chip's USB download mode. Not affiliated with M-VAVE.

Part of Drew Robinson's FM-1 projects (https://fm-1.drewr.dev/). Latest release: 0.4.2. Requires iOS 17 or macOS 14 and Swift 6.1 or later.

- [Installing firmware](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocean/FM1Kit/main/Sources/FM1Kit/FM1Kit.docc/InstallingFirmware.md): the DocC article on checking, installing, open firmware, factory voices, resuming, iOS and testing
- [Overview and topics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocean/FM1Kit/main/Sources/FM1Kit/FM1Kit.docc/FM1Kit.md): the DocC landing page, listing every public type
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocean/FM1Kit/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release
